summary: Mimimi's supernatural pirate stealth-tactics game and final original release, expanded by the Yuki's Wish and Zagan's Ritual DLC campaigns.

entries.title: Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Yuki's Wish and Zagan's Ritual DLC

primary.version: Windows PC release with Yuki's Wish and Zagan's Ritual DLC
primary.why: Windows has the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route, broad PC storefront support, and access to both major DLC campaigns; PS5 and Xbox Series versions have no documented exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version and include both DLC expansions, Yuki's Wish and Zagan's Ritual, for the complete Shadow Gambit campaign package.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with full DLC support and flexible settings/capture.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest fidelity and most complete route.

all_releases.fidelity: Current PlayStation release with DLC support.
all_releases.reason: skip: no documented exclusive content over Windows.

all_releases.fidelity: Current Xbox release with DLC support.
all_releases.reason: skip: no documented exclusive content over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is both highest fidelity and complete with the two DLC campaigns.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; Hooded Horse later took over publishing rights for long-term availability.
